searchText: > weighing the option of an additional 10% improvement vs the complexity of any of the proposed alternative strategies that might get us that 10%, I continue to lean towards the very boring approach of fixed-size chunking for code merklization. wait, how would fixed-size chunking solve the "is the first byte in PUSHDATA" problem? Or is the idea to add extra metadata to each chunk to resolve that? Extra meta data, either part of the chunk like an extra prefixed byte or maybe with the meta data merklized separately so it is two tries combined to a trie of two tries to keep it separate (only if there is a compelling reason to do so).
